newsitem.title: UK: BT in alliance with Portugal Telecom, MCI.
newsitem.headline: BT in alliance with Portugal Telecom, MCI.

text.p: British Telcommunications Plc, one of the world's leading telecoms groups, said on Monday it formed a strategic alliance with MCI Communications Corp and Portugal Telecom SA to gain a strong position in fast growing markets in Portugal and Latin America.
Under the alliance, BT will take a one percent stake in Portugal Telecom, while MCI will take 0.5 percent.
Under the agreement, Portugal Telecom becomes the sole distributor for Concert Communications Services' voice products in Portugal.
The Portuguese telecoms firm and MCI will also explore activities in Brazil's $14 billion market, where Portugal Telecom already has an alliance with Telebras.
Telebras is Brazil's leading telecommunications holding company, BT said.
Opportunities in other Latin American markets will also be explored, BT said. MCI already has a presence in 17 Latin American countries.

"We are delighted to be associated with developments that will ultimately change the face of the markets in Europe and Latin America to the advantage of millions of customers," said BT chairman Sir Iain Vallance.
